literature.citation: Robertson (2002) · Mater. Sci. Eng. R 37(4–6), 129–281
literature.title: Diamond-like amorphous carbon
literature.takeaway: Foundational bonding map: ion subplantation (<250 °C, 1–3 GPa stress) vs. thermal H2 desorption above 450–550 °C yielding dense, zero-shrinkage, low-stress sp²-crosslinked amorphous carbon.

literature.citation: Ferrari & Robertson (2004) · Phil. Trans. R. Soc. A 362(1824), 2477–2512
literature.title: Raman spectroscopy of amorphous, nanostructured, diamond-like carbon, and nanodiamond
literature.takeaway: Three-stage Raman trajectory linking G-peak dispersion, I(D)/I(G) ratio, bound H content, and sp²/sp³ clustering during thermal annealing.

literature.citation: Liu, Mui, Lill et al. — Applied Materials (2003) · Proc. SPIE 5040, 841
literature.title: Generating sub-30-nm polysilicon gates using PECVD amorphous carbon as hardmask and anti-reflective coating
literature.takeaway: Seminal Applied Materials disclosure introducing high-temperature PECVD Advanced Patterning Film (APF) amorphous carbon with high etch selectivity and O2/N2 ashability.

literature.citation: Lee, Won, Choi et al. (2011) · Thin Solid Films 519(20), 6683
literature.title: Comparative study on the properties of amorphous carbon layers deposited from 1-hexene and propylene for dry etch hard mask application
literature.takeaway: Shows lower H/C precursor stoichiometry and higher C=C crosslinking increase ACL film density and fluorocarbon plasma etch resistance.

literature.citation: Kwon, Park, Seo et al. (2013) · Thin Solid Films 531, 328–332
literature.title: Relationship between bonding characteristics and etch-durability of amorphous carbon layer
literature.takeaway: Proves fluorocarbon dry-etch durability scales with low bound H% and high interconnected C(sp²+sp³) atomic density rather than polymeric sp³-CHx.

literature.citation: Kim, Kim, Kim et al. (2016) · Diamond Relat. Mater. 69, 102–107
literature.title: Strain-controlled boron and nitrogen doping of amorphous carbon layers for hard mask applications
literature.takeaway: Demonstrates how trivalent nitrogen doping into PECVD ACL relaxes over-constrained carbon rings, lowering intrinsic compressive stress and wafer bow/cracking.

literature.citation: Jiang, Zhu, Sun et al. (2021) · Electronics 10(12), 1374
literature.title: Process Optimization of Amorphous Carbon Hard Mask in Advanced 3D-NAND Flash Memory Applications
literature.takeaway: Benchmarks C2H2 vs. C3H6 PECVD ACL for 3D-NAND: raising temperature lowers FTIR C–H stretch intensity, improves thickness uniformity, and boosts HAR oxide/nitride etch selectivity.

literature.citation: Park / Cho et al. (2021) · Materials 14(11), 2941 (PMC8198839)
literature.title: Ion-Enhanced Etching Characteristics of sp²-Rich Hydrogenated Amorphous Carbons in CF4 Plasmas and O2 Plasmas
literature.takeaway: Quantifies Steinbrüchel ion-enhanced etch thresholds on sp²-rich PECVD a-C:H: E_th = 156 eV in CF4 plasma vs. E_th = 12 eV in O2/reactive trim plasma.

literature.citation: Jung / Lee et al. (2019) · Sci. Rep. 9, 19064 (PMC6908623)
literature.title: First principles investigation on energetics, structure, and mechanical properties of amorphous carbon films doped with B, N, and Cl
literature.takeaway: DFT proof on 64-atom a-C networks (1.56–7.81 at.% N): N doping relaxes average bond angles (111.1° -> 109.3°) and raises F-penetration activation barrier E_a from 1.74 eV to 4.92 eV.

literature.citation: Al-Kuhaili / Omer et al. (2022) · Sci. Rep. 12, 9902 (PMC9197845)
literature.title: Amorphous carbon nitride dual-function anti-reflection coating for crystalline silicon solar cells
literature.takeaway: Provides cross-sectional FESEM (23–137 nm), EDS N/C ratios (0.25–0.37), and Raman D/G + C≡N (2150 cm⁻¹) temperature maps for deposited CNx films.

literature.citation: Pardanaud, Martin et al. (2015) · arXiv:1501.01464
literature.title: Thermal stability and long term hydrogen/deuterium release from soft to hard amorphous carbon layers analyzed using in-situ Raman spectroscopy
literature.takeaway: Tracks in-situ Raman G-band upshift (1505 -> 1572 cm⁻¹), Γ_G narrowing, and H2/D2 thermal release from 200 °C to 700 °C across 29–38 at.% H a-C:H films.

literature.citation: Kopp / Beyer et al. (2024) · arXiv:2410.15487
literature.title: Low-temperature fabrication of amorphous carbon films as a universal template for remote epitaxy
literature.takeaway: Characterizes smooth amorphous carbon films via XRR Kiessig fringes, XPS C1s sp²/sp³ deconvolution, sub-nm AFM, and Raman D/G spectroscopy.

literature.citation: Paul & Clough (2000) · MRS Proc. 558, 149 (arXiv:cond-mat/0007511)
literature.title: Substrate Sensitivity of the Adhesion and Material Properties of RF-PECVD Amorphous Carbon
literature.takeaway: SEM micrographs demonstrating how local DC self-bias steps over patterned topography alter RF-PECVD a-C:H stress and trigger edge delamination/buckling.

literature.citation: Li & Chae (2023) · Korean J. Chem. Eng. 40(6), 1268
literature.title: Hydrogenated amorphous carbon films deposited using plasma enhanced chemical vapor deposition processes
literature.takeaway: Reviews PECVD a-C:H plasma parameters governing film density, sp²/sp³ hybridization, optical k, and halogen plasma etch selectivity.

literature.citation: Bae et al. (2023) · Vacuum 210, 111867
literature.title: Manipulation of etch selectivity of silicon nitride over silicon dioxide to a-carbon by controlling substrate temperature with a CF4/H2 plasma
literature.takeaway: Quantifies how dense amorphous carbon hardmasks preserve ultra-high SiN/SiO2 selectivity during HAR CF4/H2 fluorocarbon etching.

literature.citation: Cheng et al. (2019) · IEEE Symp. VLSI Technol., T154
literature.title: Fin Bending Mitigation and Local Layout Effect Alleviation in Advanced FinFET Technology through Material Engineering
literature.takeaway: Shows why post-cure shrinkage in low-temperature flowable CVD gap-fill bends fragile HAR fins/pillars, motivating zero-shrinkage high-T PECVD carbon.

literature.citation: De Bleecker, Bogaerts & Goedheer (2006) · Phys. Rev. E 73(2), 026405
literature.title: Detailed modeling of hydrocarbon nanoparticle nucleation in acetylene discharges
literature.takeaway: Models 41-species 13.56 MHz C2H2 CCP chemistry up to C12: proves electrostatically trapped C2nH⁻ anions drive consecutive C2H2 polymerization into dust.

literature.citation: Ariskin, Schweigert, Alexandrov, Bogaerts & Peeters (2009) · J. Appl. Phys. 105(6), 063305 (arXiv:0809.2177)
literature.title: Modeling of chemical processes in the low pressure capacitive radio frequency discharges in a mixture of Ar/C2H2
literature.takeaway: 146-reaction hybrid Boltzmann-fluid model of Ar + 5.8% C2H2 (matching 650 sccm C2H2 in 10.5 slm Ar!) at 13.56 MHz: discharge becomes ~30% electronegative with heavy anions trapped in the bulk.

literature.citation: Baby, Mahony & Maguire (2011) · Plasma Sources Sci. Technol. 20(1), 015003 (arXiv:0811.4402)
literature.title: Acetylene–argon plasmas measured at a biased substrate electrode for diamond-like carbon deposition: I. Mass spectrometry
literature.takeaway: Quadrupole mass spectrometry of C2H2:Ar plasmas proving strong Ar dilution shifts ion bombardment to clean Ar⁺ while C2H and C4H2 diacetylene carry neutral growth.

literature.citation: Baby, Mahony & Maguire (2011) · Plasma Sources Sci. Technol. 20(1), 015004 (arXiv:0811.4407)
literature.title: Acetylene–argon plasmas measured at a biased substrate electrode for diamond-like carbon deposition: II. Ion energy distributions
literature.takeaway: Measures mass-resolved IEDFs of Ar⁺, ArH⁺, C2H2⁺, C4H2⁺ at 8.3 vs. 27 MHz substrate bias and links mean ion energy to DLC Raman I(D)/I(G) and hardness.

literature.citation: Lin, Orazbayev, Hénault et al. (2017) · J. Appl. Phys. 122(16), 163302
literature.title: Effects of gas temperature, pressure, and discharge power on nucleation time of nano-particles in low pressure C2H2/Ar RF plasmas
literature.takeaway: Tracks RF self-bias V_dc transients to measure C2H2/Ar dust nucleation time τ_nuc: proves τ_nuc rises exponentially with gas temperature T_g and drops with pressure P and RF power.

literature.citation: Berndt, Kovačević, Stefanović & Winter (2005) · arXiv:physics/0411117
literature.title: Gas temperature effect on the time for onset of particle nucleation in argon diluted acetylene plasma
literature.takeaway: FTIR in-situ extinction measurements showing even a modest gas-temperature rise (27 °C -> 80 °C) delays Ar/C2H2 nanoparticle nucleation onset by >2x.

literature.citation: Kim, Kim, Park et al. (2017) · J. Vac. Sci. Technol. A 36(2), 021506
literature.title: Characterization of particle generated during plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition on amorphous carbon layer using particle beam mass spectrometer
literature.takeaway: Direct PBMS measurements on industrial C2H2 PECVD ACL exhaust: higher C2H2 enlarges particles, higher RF power multiplies count, and NH3 addition shrinks BOTH particle diameter and concentration.

literature.citation: Bell, Lacerda, Teo, Chhowalla & Milne (2004) · Appl. Phys. Lett. 85(7), 1137–1139
literature.title: Plasma composition during plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition of carbon nanotubes [C2H2:NH3 mass spectrometry]
literature.takeaway: Direct C2H2:NH3 PECVD mass spectrometry proving amorphous carbon soot is chemically scavenged into volatile HCN gas, optimal near NH3/C2H2 ≈ 0.25–0.45.

literature.citation: Han, Lee, Jung et al. (2002) · Thin Solid Films 409(1), 120–125
literature.title: NH3 effect on the growth of carbon nanotubes on glass substrate in plasma enhanced chemical vapor deposition
literature.takeaway: Demonstrates selective atomic-H and NHx chemical etching of disordered amorphous carbon overgrowth at elevated PECVD temperatures.

literature.citation: Tetard, Michau, Prasanna, Hassouni et al. (2021) · Plasma Sources Sci. Technol. 30(10), 105015
literature.title: Discharge dynamics, plasma kinetics and gas flow effect in argon–acetylene discharges
literature.takeaway: Showerhead 13.56 MHz Ar/C2H2 CCP fluid-flow-chemistry model proving convective residence time τ_res bifurcates monomer radical flux from heavy polyyne cluster growth.

literature.citation: azin / Ghoranneviss et al. (2017) · Sci. Rep. 7, 9699 (PMC5567319)
literature.title: Study on Physio-chemical Properties of plasma polymerization in C2H2/N2 plasma
literature.takeaway: Provides OES spectra (Hα 656.5 nm, C2 515.9 nm, CH 430.3 nm, N2⁺ 390.8 nm), ATR-FTIR C=N/C≡N peaks, and shows nitrogen ratio R=1->3 cuts AFM RMS roughness from 2.89 nm to 1.42 nm.

literature.citation: Orazbayev / Ramazanov et al. (2022) · ACS Omega 7(48), 44223 (PMC9798781)
literature.title: Synthesis of Nanoparticles and Theoretical Model of Their Retention in Plasma of RF Capacitive Discharge with Vertically Arranged Electrodes in Acetylene
literature.takeaway: Quantifies negative charge Z_p (12.9 -> 1160 e) and electrostatic sheath trapping of 5–400 nm carbon nanoparticles in C2H2 RF CCP discharges.

literature.citation: Williams / Thomas et al. (2025) · arXiv:2504.21217
literature.title: Electron magnetization effects on carbonaceous dusty nanoparticles grown in Ar/C2H2 capacitively coupled nonthermal plasma
literature.takeaway: Captures cyclic OES intensity oscillations, growth rates, and high-resolution SEM micrographs of spherical carbonaceous dusty nanoparticles nucleated in Ar/C2H2 CCP.

literature.citation: Bera, Rauf, Ramaswamy & Collins — Applied Materials (2009) · J. Vac. Sci. Technol. A 27(4), 706–711
literature.title: Effects of interelectrode gap on high frequency and very high frequency capacitively coupled plasmas
literature.takeaway: Applied Materials CCP chamber modeling showing how gap d interacts with 13.56 MHz vs. VHF (27+ MHz) to control n_e, sheath drop V_sh, and radial uniformity.

literature.citation: Lee, Graves & Lieberman (2008) · Plasma Sources Sci. Technol. 17(1), 015018

literature.citation: Yang & Kushner (2010) · Plasma Sources Sci. Technol. 19(5), 055011
literature.title: Modeling of dual frequency capacitively coupled plasma sources utilizing a full-wave Maxwell solver: I. Scaling with high frequency

literature.title: Secondary electrons in dual-frequency capacitive radio frequency discharges

literature.title: Learning Similarity-Reduced Ion Kinetics across Scales and Regimes in Capacitively Coupled Plasmas

literature.title: Particle-in-cell simulation of a 50 mTorr capacitively coupled argon discharge over a range of frequencies

literature.citation: Zhu, Wei, Zhang & Xu (Jul 2026) · arXiv:2607.18103

literature.title: A fundamental feature scale model for low pressure deposition processes

literature.title: Integrated feature scale modeling of plasma processing of porous and solid SiO2. I. Fluorocarbon etching

literature.title: Superconformal chemical vapor deposition of thin films in deep features

literature.citation: Talukdar, Girolami & Abelson (2019) · J. Vac. Sci. Technol. A 37(2), 021509
literature.title: Seamless fill of deep trenches by chemical vapor deposition: Use of a molecular growth inhibitor to eliminate pinch-off
literature.takeaway: Proves two-species Knudsen mechanism: site blocking drops β_eff while rapid wall loss of inhibitor/etchant creates a depth gradient eliminating keyhole voids.

literature.citation: Abelson & Girolami (2020) · J. Vac. Sci. Technol. A 38(3), 030802
literature.title: New strategies for conformal, superconformal, and ultrasmooth films by low temperature chemical vapor deposition
literature.takeaway: Comprehensive review of Thiele modulus scaling (Φ² ∝ AR²·β_eff), co-flowed site inhibitors, and V-shaped bottom-up closure without seams.

literature.title: Competitive co-diffusion as a route to enhanced step coverage in chemical vapor deposition
literature.takeaway: Cross-sectional SEM in 10:1 AR trenches at 550 °C + 500 nm LHAR structures showing heavy inert co-diffusion boosts step coverage from SC=0.69 to SC=0.97 and penetration from 15 to 25 µm.

literature.title: Vapor-deposited zeolitic imidazolate frameworks as gap-filling ultra-low-k dielectrics
literature.takeaway: IMEC cross-sectional TEM/EDS benchmarks of sub-100 nm (45 nm half-pitch) interconnect trench vapor gap-fill and overburden planarization.

literature.title: Development of Particle-in-Cell Simulation in a Two Dimensional Trench Geometry
literature.takeaway: 2D trench PIC-MCC simulations resolving potential bending, ion angular dispersion, and sidewall vs. bottom ion bombardment flux.

literature.takeaway: Details pulsed/cyclical plasma-assisted silicon-free carbon gap-fill controlling radical surface reactions to prevent top-pinching in deep recesses.

literature.takeaway: Maps multiscale plasma informatics connecting external chamber knobs -> gas/sheath physics -> HAR feature profile extraction -> Bayesian recipe discovery.

literature.takeaway: Adapts Gaussian Process Bayesian Optimization to chamber wall seasoning and run-to-run drift during plasma-enhanced thin-film deposition.

literature_logic_rules.title: 12 Peer-Reviewed Causal Logic & Guardrail Rules for PECVD Carbon Gap-Fill

rules.title: Langevin C2nH- Anion Polymerization Guard
rules.description: De Bleecker (2006) & Lin (2017): Above 20.2 Torr with <9.2 slm Ar sweep, residence time tau_res exceeds C2H- -> C12H- chain induction time tau_nuc (tau_nuc ~ P^-2.15), nucleating 50-150 nm carbon dust nodules.
rules.equation: η_dust = τ_nuc / τ_res ∝ P^(-3.15) · Q_Ar · exp(T_g / T_0) >= 1.5

rules.title: Bell HCN Volatile Carbon Scavenging Window (N/C 0.30-0.42)
rules.description: Bell et al. (2004) & Kim et al. (2017): NH3/C2H2 in [0.30, 0.42] converts sticky C2Hx oligomers into volatile HCN(g) while passivating dangling surface bonds (-C-H / -C-NH2).
rules.equation: C2Hx + NHx• -> HCN(g)↑ + H2(g),   β_eff = β_0 exp(-k_pass θ_NHx)

rules.title: Nitrile Over-Doping Network Termination Hazard (N/C > 0.43)
rules.description: Al-Kuhaili (2022) & Ghoranneviss (2017): Excess nitrogen (N/C > 0.43) forms terminal nitrile -C≡N (2150-2200 cm^-1) bonds that break sp2 crosslinking, dropping density <1.70 g/cm3 and degrading CF4 etch resistance.

rules.title: VHF 27.12 MHz Low-Sheath-Voltage High-Dissociation Synergy
rules.description: Bera (2009), Baby (2011) & Zhang (2026): Switching from 13.56 to 27.12 MHz boosts electron density ~2.7x while dropping collisional ion energy E_i ~1.8x, preventing hole-mouth sputtering cusps.

rules.title: Griffith Strain-Energy Overburden Delamination Limit
rules.description: Paul & Clough (2000), Kim (2016) & Slide-1 Coupons A29-2/A30-2: Strain energy release rate G = sigma^2 * t_OB / (2 E') exceeds interfacial toughness G_c when planar OB > 155 nm.

rules.title: High-T (>572 C) Thermal H2 Effusion Depassivation
rules.description: Pardanaud (2015) & Robertson (2002): Above 572 C with NH3 < 190 sccm, thermal recombinative H2 desorption strips -C-H surface termination faster than NHx replenishment, raising sticking beta_eff at hole mouths.

rules.title: N-Doped Ring-Strain Relief & 4.92 eV Fluorine Etch Barrier
rules.description: Jung et al. (Sci. Rep. 2019) & Kim (2016): Moderate N doping (N/C 0.31-0.40 at 545-570 C) relaxes C-C-C bond angles (111.13 -> 109.32 deg) and raises the F-atom penetration barrier from 1.74 eV to 4.92 eV.

rules.title: Steinbruchel Selective Top-Field Trim Window (12 eV < E_i << 156 eV)
rules.description: Cho et al. (Materials 2021) & Sankaran (2004): Collisional ions at 12-28 eV exceed the reactive H/NHx/O trim threshold (12 eV) on the exposed top field (view factor 2*pi) while remaining 6x below physical/CF4 sputtering (156 eV).

rules.title: Abelson Two-Species Superconformal Knudsen Mobility Criterion
rules.description: Talukdar & Abelson (2019, 2020) & Souqui (Nat. Commun. 2024): Keeping effective sticking probability beta_eff < 0.012 (>85 ballistic wall bounces) allows carbon radicals to reach z = 1000 nm in AR=9.1 circular holes.
rules.equation: Φ_hole = √(6 · AR² · β_eff),   SC = sech(Φ_hole) · Boost_inhibitor

rules.title: Convective Argon Residence-Time Sweep (Slide-2 Ar 10k vs 7k)
rules.description: Tetard (2021) & Slide-2 13 MHz Screening: Raising Ar carrier flow >=10 slm shortens chamber residence time tau_res below ~22 ms, flattening the high-pressure oligomer overburden spike seen at Ar = 7 slm.
rules.equation: τ_res = (π R² d · P / Q_total) · (T_0 / T_g)

rules.title: Narrow-Gap High-Power Sheath Arcing & Roughness Guard
rules.description: Bera (2009), Zhu (2026) & Ghoranneviss (2017 Table 4): Narrow gap (<=415 mils) combined with high RF power (>=1850 W) amplifies nonlinear sheath harmonic fields and increases film RMS roughness >3.5x.
rules.equation: E_sheath ∝ V_RF / s_m,   RMS roughness 1.02 -> 3.78 nm with excess RF power

rules.title: 2-Step In-Situ Ar/NH3 Dep-Trim Overburden Shave
rules.description: Lam Research US 11,049,716 B2 & Applied Materials US 11,133,178 B2: Applying 15-35% Ar/NH3 trim fraction selectively removes planar overburden and upper collar cusps without reopening a closed HAR plug.
rules.equation: t_OB,final = t_OB,dep · (1 - α_trim · f_trim),   F_view(z=0)=1 >> F_view(z=L)
